name: iMessage — the bug (vertical)
description: Vertical (TikTok/Reels) reflow of the live iOS Messages conversation — the thread widens to the vertical safe-area while the choreography holds. Over ~6s: a gray received bubble pops in, a three-dot typing indicator appears and resolves into the next bubble, the channel's highlighter draws over the hero line inside that gray bubble (multiply, so the dark text stays readable), a heart tapback pops onto it, then a blue sent reply arrives with a Delivered → Read receipt, and it holds. Faithful iOS Messages look BY DESIGN: white page, gray (left) / blue (right) bubbles with tail curls, an iOS header (back chevron, contact avatar + name, FaceTime icon) — NOT a web page (no browser chrome), flat screen (no paper grain), and NO CSS glow on the captured card. Transparent WebM overlay, composited over footage.
